name: optimised
title: Lever bench: optimised lever
description: Specimen C (and D, the variant both): the stiffest layout of the same mass that rulecad's optimiser finds for the bench's load (problems/lever.json), and for D, for an angled load too.
orientation: Flat on the bed. 100% infill (or walls enough to be solid), 0.2 mm layers, the same filament as the other specimens.

problem.rule: The optimisation problem: the bench's load, or (lever:both) an angled one too

target.rule: Every specimen's volume: the same share of the envelope
target.label: Volume
